Strategy rules

Strategy: HA Pattern Reversal at RSI Extremes

Enter long on oversold doji

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN an HA doji within threshold 0.1 (ha_doji(0.1)) AND RSI crosses below 30 (oversold) (rsi_oversold(30))
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 + take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit long on bearish strong

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN a strong bearish HA candle (ha_strong_bearish())
THEN close the position

Enter short on overbought doji

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN an HA doji within threshold 0.1 (ha_doji(0.1)) AND RSI crosses above 70 (overbought) (rsi_overbought(70))
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 - take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit short on bullish strong

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN a strong bullish HA candle (ha_strong_bullish())
THEN close the position
